name: w1-wrench
eval: (async()=>{const g=window.__game,c=g.ctx,A=c.arms;const mk=c.state.communities.portage.rafts.get('market');const V=c.player.position.constructor;const P=mk.worldPoint(new V(2,mk.deck+0.05,1.5));const up=c.player.update.bind(c.player);c.player.update=(dt)=>{up(dt);c.player.position.copy(P);c.player.velocity.set(0,0,0);c.player.mode='foot';};c.player.mode='foot';c.player.teleport(P);c.player.yaw=-2.2;c.player.pitch=-0.05;A.give('pipe_wrench');A.state.drawn=-1;A.draw(0);A.cur.cond=0.55;A.cur.salt=0.35;A.rebuildVM();for(let i=0;i<40;i++){g.step(1);await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,0));}A.update=(dt)=>{};const m=A.mesh;m.position.set(0.02,-0.02,-0.55);m.rotation.set(0.1,1.45,1.2);c.camera.fov=50;c.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();})()
